newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka bourse chief granted bail in share price case.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka bourse chief granted bail in share price case.

text.p: Dhaka Stock Exchange Chairman Imtiyaz Husain, facing arrest for alleged manipulation of share prices, surrendered to the High Court on Sunday and was granted bail, court officials said.
They said the court also granted bail to 17 other brokers and company officials including Runa Alam, head of SES Securities Ltd and chief of Peregrine Capital Limited in Bangladesh.
Leading industrialist Salman Rahman and three top executives of his Beximco group of companies were granted bail on Thursday.

The arrest warrants were issued on Wednesday by the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate's court after the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the capital market watchdog, presented its case against 36 leading stock market players.

The SEC based its case on a report issued by a committee of enquiry headed by professor Amirul islam Chowdhury, which said the 36 had been involved in "fraudulent activities" causing unusual fluctuations in share prices and losses to investors.
